title: pvClean
body:
## pvClean

Cleans polygonal data: merges duplicate or nearby points, removes unused points and converts degenerate cells to lower-dimensional forms (a triangle with two merged points becomes a line, a zero-length line a point). Use it before operations that need connected topology, such as featureEdges, normals, pvDecimate or connectivity, on surfaces with duplicated vertices (STL, per-face exports). clean is the curated version; cleanGrid handles unstructured grids.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- With the default Tolerance 0 only exactly coincident points merge; a relative tolerance is a fraction of the bounding-box diagonal, so even 0.001 can merge real detail on a large model.
- Input must be polydata; use cleanGrid or pvCleantoGrid for unstructured grids.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Clean`. Identity: `filters/CleanPolyData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input to the Clean filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AbsoluteTolerance` | If merging nearby points (see PointMerging property) and using absolute tolerance (see ToleranceIsAbsolute property), this property specifies the tolerance for performing merging in the spatial units of the input data set. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ConvertLinesToPoints` | If this property is set to 1, degenerate lines (a "line" whose endpoints are at the same spatial location) will be converted to points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ConvertPolysToLines` | If this property is set to 1, degenerate polygons (a "polygon" with only two distinct point coordinates) will be converted to lines. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ConvertStripsToPolys` | If this property is set to 1, degenerate triangle strips (a triangle "strip" containing only one triangle) will be converted to triangles. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PieceInvariant` | If this property is set to 1, the whole data set will be processed at once so that cleaning the data set always produces the same results. If it is set to 0, the data set can be processed one piece at a time, so it is not necessary for the entire data set to fit into memory; however the results are not guaranteed to be the same as they would be if the Piece invariant option was on. Setting this option to 0 may produce seams in the output dataset when ParaView is run in parallel. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PointMerging` | If this property is set to 1, then points will be merged if they are within the specified Tolerance or AbsoluteTolerance (see the Tolerance and AbsoluteTolerance properties), depending on the value of the ToleranceIsAbsolute property. (See the ToleranceIsAbsolute property.) If this property is set to 0, points will not be merged. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Tolerance` | If merging nearby points (see PointMerging property) and not using absolute tolerance (see ToleranceIsAbsolute property), this property specifies the tolerance for performing merging as a fraction of the length of the diagonal of the bounding box of the input data set. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ToleranceIsAbsolute` | This property determines whether to use absolute or relative (a percentage of the bounding box) tolerance when performing point merging. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvClean",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
